kevin (PM): Quick sync — LumosFin wants a reserved-pool pilot. Key asks: 99.9 p99 on checkout paths, small prepaid burst allowance, and two guaranteed 90m demo windows. Sales needs a signed playbook by next Wed. Can eng + ops agree on a minimal admit/rollback plan?
anya (Eng-Platform): High-level proposal: baseline commit + per-tenant burst bucket (decaying), promo windows that temporarily increase bucket, and fallback path to smaller model plus throttle if needed. We'll define cooldowns to avoid autoscale thrash.
samir (SRE): Ops notes: per-tenant accounting mandatory, alert when any tenant burns >40% pool burst in 10m. Emergency kill switch required (pool-scoped) that can be auto-triggered by SLO impact. Prewarm will cost; finance signoff needed.
nina (Product Ops): Sales wants demo windows both for launch week and a second show. Prefer gated promo windows we can schedule instead of always-on burst. Also need customer notification templates.
diego (Sales): LumosFin will pay for demo windows. They want minimal visible failures in production. Fallback + banner notification is acceptable.
policy-bot: feature-check: reserved-pools:enabled, emergency-kill:flagged
anya (Eng-Platform): Admit-rule sketch (compact):
```
mode: reserved
baseline_qps: 12
burst_tokens: 700000
burst_decay: 24h_half_life
promo_window_secs: 5400
prewarm_gpus: 1
spill_behavior: fallback_then_throttle
cooldown_secs: promo_window_secs + 300
rollback: drain_then_block
```
samir (SRE): Clarify spill_behavior: fallback_then_throttle = route to smaller model + emit event; if pool pressure persists or tokens exhausted then start per-tenant throttle. Add billing event when fallback triggers.
kevin (PM): For pilot gating we need: 1) admit schema in staging; 2) escrow accounting + billing event; 3) dashboards + alerts; 4) kill switch tested; 5) sales playbook + notification templates.
anya (Eng-Platform): Ops decisions to finalize: eviction scoring (score = alpha*commit + beta*recent_burn), cooldown formula (agree on promo_window + 300s), and exact token decay function (we'll default to 24h half-life).
diego (Sales): Include webhook for fallback events so LumosFin can show a banner during degraded mode. Also need a one-paragraph customer-facing fallback description for the contract.
samir (SRE): I'll add alert: page if a tenant would require throttling >60% of pool to keep SLOs for 5m. That will auto-block tenant and page oncall.
nina (Product Ops): Owners / ETAs:
- anya -> finalize admit-rule schema + sample configs + PR (ETA Tue)
- samir -> alerts + kill-switch spec + chaos test plan (ETA Wed)
- diego -> customer notification copy + demo pricing (ETA Thu)
- kevin -> prewarm cost estimate & signoff path (ETA Thu)
policy-bot: task-created:reserved-pool-handbook-pr
kevin (PM): If schema + metrics land this week we can lock LumosFin pilot and schedule demo windows in week 2. Thanks all :rocket:
